title: Exact sparse spectrum polynomial runtime bound
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, let $R(n,k)$ denote the exact sparse spectrum runtime scale. The polynomial runtime bound is $1+2^{171}(12R(n,k))^{100}$.
caveat: The exact sparse spectrum runtime scale is referenced but its definition is not included.
